items.title: Akiyoshi Toshiko — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he said, one time he said, “Well, why don‟t we write together?”

ctx.x: …but he was such a sensitive writer. He—I think we might have been the same age, I‟m not quite sure [Takemitsu was born in 1930, ten months after Akiyoshi]— he was a very frail person and drank quite a lot, so he had to be very careful about eating and so on. And he said, one time he said, “Well, why don‟t we write together?”
